facts.text: The hotel looks out over the White House, Lafayette Square and St. John's Church.
facts.excerpt: Surrounded by unparalleled views of the White House, Lafayette Square, and St. John's Church

facts.text: The Hay-Adams was originally designed and built as a residential hotel in the 1920s.
facts.excerpt: originally designed and built as a residential hotel in the 1920s

facts.text: The hotel's address is 800 16th St. NW, Washington, D.C.
facts.excerpt: 800 16th St. NW, Washington, D.C. 20006

facts.text: The lobby is wood-paneled.
facts.excerpt: The wood-paneled lobby reveres the hotel's historic past without feeling stuffy.

facts.text: The interiors combine Corinthian, Doric and Ionic columns, walnut wainscoting, and ceilings with Elizabethan, Italian and Tudor motifs.
facts.excerpt: Corinthian, Doric, and Ionic columns, walnut wainscoting, and ceiling treatments with Elizabethan, Italian, and Tudor motifs

facts.text: The Federal Suite, the Presidential Suite and the White House View Junior Suites have private balconies with views of the White House.
facts.excerpt: book The Federal Suite, Presidential Suite or one of the White House View Junior Suites; you'll be rewarded with some epic views of the White House from your private balcony

facts.text: The Lafayette is the hotel's fine-dining restaurant, serving upscale contemporary American cuisine.
facts.excerpt: Upscale contemporary American cuisine meets modern elegance and personalized service in our fine dining restaurant.

facts.text: The Lafayette is filled with natural light by day and candlelight in the evening.
facts.excerpt: By day, natural light envelops you, and by evening, candlelight sets an intimate mood.

facts.text: The Lafayette's Private Dining Room has an ornamental fireplace and views of Lafayette Park.
facts.excerpt: With its ornamental fireplace and views of Lafayette Park, The Lafayette's refined Private Dining Room offers a touch of exclusivity.

facts.text: Off The Record, the hotel's bar, displays a collection of artwork created by editorial cartoonists.
